t: What Rifle Does Spencer Dutton Use in the 1923 World Series?
s: January 14, 2024 - Spencer Dutton used a Winchester Model 1894 rifle in 1923. This rifle was chambered in .30-30 Winchester and was a popular choice for hunters and law enforcement officers at the time. The Model 1894 was a reliable and accurate rifle that was well-suited for hunting deer and other big game.
